artworks.title: Christ Child in the Sacred Heart
artworks.medium: woodcut in warm black, hand-colored in red lake, blue, green, yellow, and gold
artworks.description: This is a painting of a figure inside a heart, atop a cross-like structure. The heart is deep red, and within it is a small figure painted in light flesh tones, adorned with a blue head covering, holding a feather or palm leaf in one hand while grasping a small red object in the other. Surrounding the heart are blue and red feather-like elements, and beneath is a field of green. Above the heart, a green garland and additional colorful abstract shapes occupy the sky, framed by a blue skyline. The image has a naive, folkloric aesthetic.

artworks.title: Christ as Salvator Mundi
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: The image shows a standing figure with an extended arm and hand. The person has a halo around their head, straight shoulder-length hair, and a beard. They wear an intricately designed robe with a detailed pattern and a collar, holding an orb topped with a cross in their left hand. The background is plain with a simple border framing the image.

artworks.title: Christ as Salvator Mundi
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures on a green ground with a blue sky background. One figure stands at the center with long hair, a beard, and a halo, wearing a flowing robe. To the left, another figure in a yellow robe stands with curly hair and a halo. On the right, a figure in a red robe gazes towards the central figure while holding a sphere with a cross on it. The scene is framed in a thin border.

artworks.title: Good Shepherd
artworks.medium: woodcut in warm black, hand-colored in yellow, green-gray, and rose

artworks.title: Christ as the Man of Sorrows
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, and yellow
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a slightly hunched position. The individual has long, dark hair and is wearing a crown of leaves on their head. Their facial expression is downcast, with closed eyes and a solemn demeanor. The person is minimally clothed, wearing only a simple waistcloth. They are holding a bundle of green branches against their chest and are surrounded by various objects, including spears, sticks, and a rooster. The background features an intricately detailed border with floral and vine motifs in green and red.

artworks.title: Christ as the Man of Sorrows
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in yellow, ochre, brown and indian red
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure seated with a crown of thorns, surrounded by tools of crucifixion. The figure is depicted sitting on a large wooden structure resembling part of a cross, with hands bound and a sorrowful expression. The background features a cityscape with spires and rooftops. Various tools, including nails, a hammer, and pincers, are scattered at the base. This illustration consists of detailed line work indicative of woodcut prints, presenting a portrayal of the scene, accompanied by text along the top and bottom sections.

artworks.title: Christ as the Man of Sorrows
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, orange, blue, yellow, and green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a figure with a halo and crown of thorns on a wooden structure. The figure is seated with a crown of thorns, hands bound, and a bleeding body. A halo is behind its head and it is against a large wooden crossbeam. Nearby, there is a rope with star-shaped spikes and nails. Above the figure are the words "ECCE HOMO" and below is text within a ribbon-like frame. The color palette consists primarily of earthy tones with accents of red to emphasize the figure's wounds.

artworks.title: Christ as the Man of Sorrows
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in dark brown, tan and rose
artworks.description: The image shows a figure sitting on a stone, wearing a crown of thorns and a cloth garment. They have a sorrowful expression with wavy shoulder-length hair and a beard. Wounds are shown on their skin. A large cross and buildings in a town are visible in the background, and the sky has a halo-like arch with text. A hand is reaching out from the top right corner.

artworks.title: The Man of Sorrows and His Mother
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in rose, blue, lilac, vermilion, mustard yellow, white, brown, and silver on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a medieval woodcut-style rendition of two figures. One figure has long brown hair and a beard, wearing a green crown of leaves and a patterned cloth. The other figure wears a deep blue and golden robe with a hood, with soft facial features and a veil blending into a halo-like shape behind their head. The figures are surrounded by a simple colored arch with text above them reading "Ecce homo." Below the central image is a block of text in a Gothic script. The background is filled with deep blue and framed with a red border with decorative motifs at the top and bottom.

artworks.title: Christ Falling Under the Weight of the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in yellow ochre, tan, green, and red
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 12.6 x 18.8 cm (4 15/16 x 7 3/8 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 39.4 x 31.8 cm (15 1/2 x 12 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man lying on the ground on his left side, with both arms extended forward. He has closed eyes, a beard, and long brown hair. He wears a crown of thorny branches and a halo, and is clothed in a robe. His bare feet and marks on his hands and feet are visible. A wooden cross partially rests on his shoulder. The background is a plain, beige surface with green areas. In the top corners are two scrolls with text in gothic script.

artworks.title: The Man of Sorrows with a Franciscan
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, blue, green-yellow, gray, and flesh
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body depiction of a figure to the left, standing upright. The facial features include closed eyes, a beard, and long wavy hair. Stripes of red streak across the figure's chest, and a red cross is visible on one shoulder. The figure has a halo around the head. Beside this figure, there is a monk-like person to the lower right, facing the first figure. The monk has a shaven hairstyle and wears a simple robe with a cowl. He appears to be speaking, with a scroll emerging from his mouth. The background is filled with decorative elements, including a floral design and swirling patterns, against a blue and golden-colored background. At the top, there is a banner with the letters "INRI."

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross with Angels
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: The image features a depiction of a crucified figure on a wooden cross, flanked by two angelic figures with wings holding cups. Below the cross is a skull and bones. To the left and right are two figures in robes, one with a covered head and pressed hands, and the other holding a hand in a gesture.

artworks.title: Christ Showing His Wounds to Peter, the Magdalene and the Good Thief
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: The image depicts four figures in full-body view, arranged in a line. The first figure on the left has long, wavy hair and a thin frame with a cloth around their waist, one hand raised. The second figure is older with short, curled hair and a beard, wearing a long robe, holding a large key and a book. The third figure has long, wavy hair, dressed in a red and teal garment, holding a cylindrical object, and also has a halo. The fourth figure is on a cross, with curly hair and a cloth around the waist, arms stretched outward. The background is a simple, lightly colored area with a blue curved line.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross with Angels
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red lake, brown, yellow, green, black, and tan
artworks.description: The image shows three main figures in a religious scene. In the center, a man is crucified on a wooden cross. Surrounding him are four angels holding chalices to collect blood. To the left is a woman and to the right, another man with a book. In the background are celestial symbols like the sun and moon.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross with Angels
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue, green, tan, brown, yellow, carmine, and gray-blue
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crucifixion scene with religious figures and angels present. The central part of the image depicts a figure on a wooden cross, surrounded by angels catching dripping blood. To the left of the cross is a figure in a blue robe with hands clasped in prayer. To the right is another figure in a green cloak holding a book. Above, the sun and moon with human-like faces appear in the sky. The background is filled with short, diagonal blue strokes. It is styled like a medieval European religious woodcut or illumination.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross with Angels
artworks.medium: woodcut on vellum

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross with Angels
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue, yellow, orange, green, brown, carmine, and gold on vellum
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crucifixion scene. The image depicts a central figure on a wooden cross, with arms outstretched and a modestly draped waist. Above the cross is the acronym "INRI." Flanking the crucified figure are two angels, each holding a chalice. Below and to the sides of the cross are two other prominent figures, both with halos. One is draped in blue and gold, holding prayerful hands, while the other is dressed in warm colors with a contemplative expression. At the foot of the cross rests a skull and crossbones on the grass. The background gradient moves from blues to earth tones. This is in the style of Albrecht Dürer with bold outlines and rich color contrasts characteristic of Renaissance religious art.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross with Angels
artworks.medium: woodcut, faintly touched in red
artworks.description: The image shows several figures surrounding a crucifixion. The main figure is on a wooden cross with outstretched arms and crossed feet, nailed in place. He has a bearded face with closed eyes, wears a crown of thorns, and is clad in a cloth around the waist. There are angels around the cross holding chalices to collect blood. To the left, a woman stands with hands clasped, wearing a robe and a halo. To the right, a man with long hair and a beard stands with hands together, also wearing a robe and halo. Below, skeletal remains are scattered on the ground.

artworks.title: The Pietà
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in yellow ochre, green, rose, and gold
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a traditional Christian iconographic style. One figure is lying on the lap of the other, who is seated. The lying figure has a solemn expression, a beard, and wears a crown of thorns. The seated figure has clasped hands over their chest, a serene expression, and possibly a halo or hood. Both figures are fully clothed. The background includes a large cross with an inscription at the top, set in a simple landscape with green coloration. The image is framed with a simple red border.

artworks.title: Pietà with Saint John
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue, red, green, ochre, orange, and gold; with additions in pen and ink
artworks.description: The image shows three figures with their full body depicted. The central figure is a male with visible rib bones, a beard, and long hair, dressed in a yellow cloth. Two other figures stand on either side of him; one is a woman in a blue robe with a hood, and the other is a female in an orange robe. Both have halos around their heads and light-colored hair flowing past their shoulders, with hands in gestures of prayer or mourning. The background shows a landscape with green grass, hills, buildings, and a large wooden cross with the letters "INRI" at the top. The sky has a blend of colors.

artworks.title: Pietà with Saint John
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red, green, tan, yellow, and black
artworks.description: This is a painting of three figures centered around a cross and a ladder, with a tree in the background. The painting depicts a scene with three figures in close proximity. One figure in a red robe is holding a vessel and seems to be engaged in an action or gesture towards the central figure, who is lying on a cloth with visible markings on the body. This central figure has a halo and wears a crown of thorns. Another figure, dressed in earth-toned robes, is kneeling with hands clasped in a gesture resembling prayer, also with a halo depicted around the head. The backdrop shows a large wooden cross, partially obscured by a tall ladder, with a tree situated to the side.

artworks.title: Christ Sitting on His Tomb with One Angel
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in carmine red and green
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures. The central figure is seated on a rectangular structure with legs bent, feet on green ground. This figure has long hair, a beard, a green crown, a halo, and is bare-chested. They are draped with a cloth. Behind them, a person in a brown robe with wings holds part of the cloth. The background has a patterned frame.

artworks.title: Christ in the Tomb with Two Angels
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, orange-yellow, blue-green, green, and gold
artworks.description: The image shows three figures mainly displaying their upper bodies. The central figure is seated, leaning against the support of two other figures on either side. The central person has long hair, a beard, closed eyes, wears a crown of thorns, and shows red marks on his body. His torso is bare with fabric around his waist. On the left and right are two angelic figures with long hair, big colorful wings, and one in a robe with patterns. The angel on the right has a hand raised. The background features architectural elements like pointed arches and stained-glass windows.

artworks.title: Christ between Maria and John
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: The image is a woodcut depicting three individuals from the chest up. In the center is Jesus with a crown of thorns and a halo, arms crossed over their bare chest. On the left is Mary wearing a headscarf and a robe, with clasped hands and a halo. On the right is another figure with shoulder-length curly hair, a halo, and a robe, likely John. The background features a wooden cross with a small plaque. The artwork is monochromatic with detailed linework.
